justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Neurological communication disorder evidence base strong; BC-ANCDS certification-specific outcomes not studied.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Academy of Neurologic Communication Disorders exam; significant documentation requirements.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable to SLPs treating neurological communication disorders in neuro and acute care settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: No BC-ANCDS billing premium; standard SLP neurological communication billing applies.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Limited employer recognition; BC-ANCDS credential not widely listed in job postings.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Neurological patients value specialized communication expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Aphasia/cognitive-communication cash-pay exists (intensive aphasia programs) but most care is insurance-based.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Niche specialty supports premium for intensive programs; broader market limited by payer mix.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: ANCDS board certification is rare and clearly signals neurogenic expertise.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Programs (e.g., aphasia camps) can scale, but credentialed clinicians are scarce to hire.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Families of stroke/TBI survivors don't search by ANCDS, though SLPs and physicians recognize it.
justifications.business.efficiency: Portfolio + exam process is substantial; not a quick credential.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Top-tier credential in CSD faculty hiring for neurogenic communication lines.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: ANCDS membership overlaps heavily with the neurogenic-comm research community.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Strong evidence base across aphasia, motor speech, TBI cognitive-communication intervention.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Frequently preferred for neurogenic faculty positions.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Heavy lift but high academic return.
